$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-make-concise (ai-advanced-capabilities-nda-r1, Contextual AI Tool Library phase 3). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests + jps-validate). Consumes the compose-selection JPS scope — the inline AI toolbar / Review-Note tools menu dispatches { selectionText, ... } via the shipped session-dispatch seam; selectionText is the load-bearing LLM input and the anchor the emitted target_text is copied from. Matter/firm playbook + precedent grounding is supplied by the retrieval layer (not a maker-provided input field). Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — use the object-level required array). Custom keywords elicitation_prompt / ledger_resolution are maker metadata (OpenAI-tolerated unknown keywords). No actionId here — it is assigned in Dataverse at deploy time. actionCode carries NO version suffix.

selectionText.description: The selected contract clause (or clause fragment) to condense. The clause the attorney highlighted in the Compose editor (or the clause a Review Note anchors to); the emitted target_text MUST be copied verbatim from this so the editor can locate and apply the edit. Capped upstream at the compose-selection scope's authored budget.
selectionText.elicitation_prompt: Which clause would you like me to make more concise? Select it in the document first.
selectionText.ledger_resolution: compose.selectionText — the current editor selection dispatched by the FR-14 inline AI toolbar (compose-selection scope), or the Review Note's anchored clause span. Matter/firm playbook + precedent grounding is supplied by the retrieval layer at dispatch time.
